_meta.rule: Only quoted provider inputs are multiplied. Unknown fees/taxes remain blank. BOC board is reference-only and date-mismatched; SkyRemit is an illustrative rate-pair scenario, not an executable quote.

fx.note: CNY per 100 USD. Arithmetic midpoint = (bid+ask)/2. One-way proxy uses (ask-mid)/ask; round-trip proxy uses (ask-bid)/ask. Neither is a tax or an executable mid-market quote.

full_arrival_optional.note: Conditional optional service; not included in base known cost. Overseas/receiving charges may still apply.

hsbc_wire.note: Ordinary third-party Premier/Advance wire. Free tiers exclude correspondent/receiving charges and taxes. HSBC FX spread and account fees are not captured.

skyremit.note: Scenario: CNY principal = target USD / final rate; transfers = ceil(principal/300000); fee assumed separate in CNY; FX loss = principal*(realtime-final); fee USD equivalent = fee*transfers*final. Provider may deduct fee from send amount; confirm live quote.

wise.note: Single dynamic capture only. No 40-point Wise curve is inferred; ladder Wise total remains blank.
